content:
Welcome to 0x1 ZeroINK — my personal blog, now rebuilt with Hugo and the PaperMod theme.
What’s new Static-first: blazing fast builds and instant page loads. PaperMod: clean typography, dark/light mode, search, archives, and reading time out of the box. Same workflow: push to main, GitHub Actions builds and deploys to GitHub Pages, and IndexNow submits the updated sitemap automatically. More posts are on the way. Stay tuned!
summary: The blog has been rebuilt with Hugo and the PaperMod theme.
